information: Please note that this is considerded to be a "quiet" competition. If you are a new cuber and interested in checking out a competition, I would recommend [SnoCo Favorites 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SnoCoFavorites2022) taking place the day before this competition at another location in Everett, as that competition will have the more common events.
